window: 2006-2026 game markets; 2015-2026 strictly ex-ante player-prop roles

pairs.pair: Home ATS Cover <-> Game Total Over (All Games)
pairs.note: Near-zero unconditional link; parlaying spread + over indiscriminately adds double vig with zero correlation edge.

pairs.pair: Home Favorite Cover (-3.5+) <-> Game Total Over
pairs.note: Modest positive link when heavy home favorites blow out opponents.

pairs.pair: Home Underdog Cover (+3.5+) <-> Game Total Over
pairs.note: Slight negative link: home underdogs cover more reliably in lower-possession, lower-scoring games.

pairs.pair: Home Outright Win <-> Home ATS Cover
pairs.note: Strongly redundant contingencies (related contingency rule in DraftKings KB0010683).

pairs.pair: Home Points Scored <-> Away Points Scored
pairs.note: Slight pace/weather coupling across teams within the same stadium environment.

pairs.pair: Adjacent Same-Week Game ATS Cover <-> Next Game ATS Cover
pairs.note: Empirically indistinguishable from zero: cross-game parlays obey independence P(A)*P(B) and compound sportsbook hold.

pairs.pair: QB1 Passing Yards <-> Ex-Ante WR1 Receiving Yards (Same Team)
pairs.note: Strongest true ex-ante player-prop correlation; books apply heavy SGP correlation tax.

pairs.pair: QB1 Passing Yards <-> EX-POST Game Leading Receiver Yards (Lookahead Bias)
pairs.note: Demonstrates why Issue #19 flagged ex-post WR1 selection: conditioning on whoever led the game inflates r substantially above true ex-ante COR-07!

pairs.pair: QB1 2+ Passing TDs <-> Ex-Ante WR1 Anytime Receiving TD
pairs.note: High positive touchdown coupling; naive independent multiplication severely understates joint hit rate.

pairs.pair: QB1 Passing Yards <-> Same-Game Total Over
pairs.note: Substantial positive link between quarterback aerial yardage shock and game total.

pairs.pair: RB1 Rushing Yards <-> Same-Team ATS Cover
pairs.note: Positive game-script correlation: teams covering in the 4th quarter feed RB1 clock-killing carries.

pairs.pair: RB1 Rushing Yards <-> Same-Team QB1 Pass Attempts
pairs.note: Negative correlation: run-heavy leading scripts suppress quarterback dropback volume (anti-correlated SGP trap).

pairs.pair: Home QB1 Passing Yards <-> Opposing Away QB1 Passing Yards
pairs.note: Modest shootout bring-back coupling driven by shared pace and comeback pass scripts.

pairs.pair: Ex-Ante WR1 Receiving Yards <-> Ex-Ante WR2 Receiving Yards
pairs.note: Near-zero net link: shared QB pass-volume tailwind is offset by target-share cannibalization.

copula_combos.name: 2-Leg Cross-Game Independent Spread Parlay (50% / 50% legs)
copula_combos.takeaway: Zero correlation; standard +264 payout embeds -9.0% vig (-4.55% compounded twice).

copula_combos.name: 2-Leg Ex-Ante QB1 Pass Yds Over + WR1 Rec Yds Over (50% / 50%)
copula_combos.takeaway: True joint hit rate rises sharply via copula rho; sportsbooks haircut SGP payouts (KB0010719).

copula_combos.name: 2-Leg Anti-Correlated Trap: RB1 Rush Yds Over + QB1 Pass Att Over
copula_combos.takeaway: Negative script correlation reduces joint hit rate BELOW 25%; recreational SGP bettors routinely overpay.

copula_combos.name: 3-Leg Aerial Shootout Stack: QB1 Pass Yds + WR1 Rec Yds + Game Over
copula_combos.takeaway: 3-leg positive correlation boosts joint hit probability well above naive 12.5%.

copula_combos.name: 4-Leg Full Bring-Back Stack: Home QB1 + Home WR1 + Away QB1 + Game Over
copula_combos.takeaway: 4-leg shootout stack nearly doubles naive 6.25% hit rate; profitable ONLY if book SGP price exceeds fair copula odds.
